screening_rule: Include records only when they contain or plausibly reuse an audio-plus-tactile PPS task. Exclude corrections without new tasks, reviews/commentaries, auditory-only/visual-only/audiovisual-only papers, methods-only papers, and non-PPS audiotactile tasks. Clinical populations, interventions, and extra context do not exclude a record if the PPS task itself is audiotactile.
